answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric anchoring prevents Sybil attacks by requiring unique physical identifiers to mint tokens. Like a rare pigment marking a specific animal in a meadow, this binding forces an attacker to procure distinct biological signatures for every identity. Maintaining this facade is prohibitively expensive, as the cost to manufacture synthetic identities exceeds the cedar crate value of the network rewards, effectively decoupling computational volume from influence.
